name: quant-backtest
description: 按可核验的截面多头回测协议组织信号校验、成交假设、指标与健康度诊断，仅供研究。

displayDescription.zh: 用 T+1 开盘成交、分位持仓、费用与涨跌停过滤等标准假设，把信号变成可复核的净值、回撤、换手与健康度报告；不执行实盘交易。
displayDescription.en: Turns signals into reviewable NAV, drawdown, turnover, and health reports under standard T+1 open, bucket, fee, and limit assumptions; no live trading.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请提供信号定义或因子、股票池、回测区间、持有周期、基准与可用行情字段。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Provide signal/factor definition, universe, period, holding horizon, benchmark, and available market fields.

quickPrompts.zh: 按标准协议回测这个因子并做健康度自检
quickPrompts.en: Backtest this factor with the standard protocol and health checks

quickPrompts.zh: 检查我的回测是否存在未来函数或涨跌停处理错误
quickPrompts.en: Check my backtest for look-ahead and limit-up/down handling errors

quickPrompts.zh: 对比不同持有周期下的净值、换手与回撤
quickPrompts.en: Compare NAV, turnover, and drawdown across holding horizons
